scope: Seven Casey REAS Art Blocks tokens received together as a focused accession lot; the three CENTURY tokens are a comparative sample, not a complete series.

artist_statement.text: The research record attributes to artist and project sources a set of distinct computational systems: CENTURY cuts and recomposes modernist references; Pre-Process models moving circle Elements; Phototaxis records artificial-life trajectories; 923 EMPTY ROOMS enumerates colorform combinations in a distributed release; and Ex Nihilo (Cosmos) translates geometric and pixel data into a continuous line field.

museum_interpretation.text: The group is read through five connected but non-identical lines of inquiry: modernist recombination, Process grammar, artificial-life drawing, finite combinatorics, and geometric/pixel simulation. Across the lot, time is part of the medium rather than decoration, so the Museum must preserve token-specific state alongside the live system that makes each state performable. This is a focused institutional comparison, not a claim of direct formal descent or an artist-defined canonical group.

collection_rationale: The group documents how a major artist's software practice enters multiple Art Blocks release contexts across 2021-2026.
It supports public study of the relation among code, token identity, live behavior, and static documentation.
It gives the Museum a coherent but bounded Casey REAS case study without claiming completeness.

relationship_to_museum_scope.text: The adopted Art Blocks donation preapproval places these works on the donation review pathway, while the adopted donation policy preserves ordinary authenticity, provenance, title, rights, technical, risk, and acceptance checks.

trait_analysis_policy.source_scope: Art Blocks descriptive metadata may be preserved; no market rarity or OpenSea metrics are used.
trait_analysis_policy.interpretive_boundary: Traits are not treated as intrinsic rarity, value, artistic quality, or accession rationale.

revision_note: This statement is revisable after independent curatorial review; corrections must be append-only amendments with supersedes lineage.
